instruction: Please convert the image file located at "/home/user/logo.png" to EPS format. I need it for print production.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP cannot natively export to EPS (Encapsulated PostScript) format. While GIMP supports many image formats, EPS export requires additional plugins or external tools that are not available in the standard GIMP installation.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible with appropriate evaluator function
GIMP genuinely lacks native EPS export capability - the infeasible classification is accurate
The infeasible() placeholder function is the semantically correct evaluator for a task that cannot be completed
No verification logic is needed or possible for an infeasible task
